notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for the standard Auto Provide switch-disabled explicit-request boundary. The source uses only the official IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, ordinary FOM, endpoint, and callback configuration. It verifies that an ordinary FOM leaves Auto Provide disabled, that discovery does not solicit a provider automatically, and that both the object-instance and object-class requestAttributeValueUpdate overloads still produce exactly the standard provideAttributeValueUpdate callback with the request tag and requested attribute. It does not assert provider-specific names, registries, headers, transport, or implementation behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador Auto Provide switch lookup, ordinary object publication, subscription, registration, explicit requestAttributeValueUpdate, unsubscription, unpublication, resignation, and disconnect services with FederateAmbassador discovery and provideAttributeValueUpdate callback boundary
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador Auto Provide and object-management declarations
